title: Explicit universe-lifted constant normalization diagram
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d and its supplied algebraic tower T [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data], lift each algebraic level by finitePerfectAdicAlgebraLift. Construct its scalar-restriction comparison by localizing the identity comparison of termwise universe-lift functors. Define finitePerfectAdicLiftedTransition as the lifted T.transition followed by the inverse comparison. For any scheme Y let finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant Y T n be the exact constant realization of the lifted level and define its transition using normalizationConstantArrow [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. All levels and arrows are constructions from T, with no chosen existence witness.
